opening: I've had a loss of vision.
I've had cataract surgery with artificial lenses put in both eyes.
Three weeks ago I was started on Simbrinza drops (brimonidine 0.1%/brinzolamide 0.1%) for my glaucoma, twice a day in both eyes.

opening.text: I've had a loss of vision that came on suddenly, and I have a headache. I've had cataract surgery with artificial lenses put in both eyes, and I have open-angle glaucoma. Three weeks ago I was started on Simbrinza drops (brimonidine 0.1%/brinzolamide 0.1%) for my glaucoma, twice a day in both eyes.
